critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 896 lines - still above the 700-line guideline. Splitting into routers (brain, tokens, launch, lab, avatars, websocket) is overdue.

update_character silently drops avatarId/voice keys instead of returning 400 when a client tries to change them - current behavior matches spec ('ignored') but a 400 or 409 would make the API self-documenting.
_mint_brain is an in-process dict; horizontal scaling (>1 pod) would see stale brainModel after PATCH. Move to Redis or re-read from DB each call.
import_token still has no per-wallet / per-IP rate limit - cheap DoS vector (DexScreener fan-out + Solana RPC call per request).
No cleanup/delete endpoint for drafted tokens; QA runs accumulate rows (I purged tokens + character_profiles collections directly via Motor during testing).
seed_data_creation: During test runs, created QA* draft tokens and imported CZJfrAmMs5Cz4H22PWzfqTJu5FkP7Q2Vvx1oPVL9pump; all cleaned up from db.tokens and db.character_profiles so the public feed is empty for the home-empty-state check.
